symbols.name: EEex_Keybinds_Cast

parameters.name: resref
parameters.description: The resref of the spell to cast.

returns.description: `true` if the casting was started successfully; `false` otherwise.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary**
> Attempts to cast `resref` as the leader of the currently selected sprites.

**Parameters:**

| **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| resref | string |  | The resref of the spell to cast. |

**Return Values:**

| **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- |
| boolean | `true` if the casting was started successfully; `false` otherwise. |

symbols.name: EEex_Keybinds_CastTwoStep

parameters.name: firstResref
parameters.description:
The resref of the first spell to cast.
This spell should invoke op214.

parameters.name: secondResref
parameters.description:
The resref of the second spell to cast.
This spell should be provided by the previously invoked op214.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary** > Attempts to cast `firstResref` → `secondResref` as the leader of the currently selected sprites. **Parameters:** | **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | firstResref | string | | The resref of the first spell to cast.
This spell should invoke op214. | | secondResref | string | | The resref of the second spell to cast.
This spell should be provided by the previously invoked op214. |

symbols.name: EEex_Keybinds_Get

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique id of the associated keybind.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary** > Returns a table representing the keybind with the given `id`. **Parameters:** | **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | id | string | | The unique id of the associated keybind. | **Return Values:** | **Type** | **Description** | | --- | --- | | table \| nil | See summary. | --- #### **The Keybind Table** | Key | Value Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | callback | function | Function that is called when the conditions required by `fireType` are satisfied. | | fireType | EEex_Keybinds_FireType | The situation in which `callback` is invoked. | | keys | table | Table of keycodes defining the keybind's main sequence of keys.
These keys must be pressed in the defined order for the keybind to be satisfied. | | modifierKeys | table | Table of keycodes defining the keys that are required to be down when the main sequence is satisfied.
Allowed keys include the left / right variants of Ctrl, Shift, and Alt. | --- #### **EEex_Keybinds_FireType** | Ordinal Name | Description | | --- | --- | | UP | Fires when any key is released after the keybind has been satisfied.
Additional key presses will cancel the satisfaction of the keybind. | | DOWN | Fires when the keybind has been satisfied. |

symbols.name: EEex_Keybinds_SelectPortrait

parameters.name: portraitIndex
parameters.description: The index of the portrait to select.

parameters.name: dontUnselect
parameters.description:
If `true`, prevents the deselection of already-selected sprites.
This is analogous to holding Shift in the original keybindings.

symbols.documentationMarkdown:
> **Summary** > Attempts to select the portrait in `portraitIndex`. **Parameters:** | **Name** | **Type** | **Default Value** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | portraitIndex | number | | The index of the portrait to select. | | dontUnselect | boolean | `false` | If `true`, prevents the deselection of already-selected sprites.
This is analogous to holding Shift in the original keybindings. |
